purpose: Verify one policy-approved exact text replacement in an isolated copied workspace.
scope: Replace one exact occurrence in one existing regular UTF-8 file.
Bind verification to the final workspace and event-chain hashes.
notInScope: Live provider calls, process execution, network access, secrets, remote writes, deployment, and release.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The replacement text is present exactly once in the target file.
The original expected text is absent from the target file.
The verified workspace hash matches the committed tool result.
The immutable source fixture hash is unchanged.

verificationMethods: Read the confined target as strict UTF-8.
Count replacement and expected text occurrences.
Recompute workspace and source fixture manifests.
runtimeEvidenceExpectations: Four named verification checks with observations and a content-addressed result.
An approved read-only evaluation bound to the exact contract, rubric, projection, workspace, and event head.
risks: Workspace confinement is not an operating-system sandbox.
A privileged concurrent same-user actor is outside this local preview threat boundary.
recoveryPath: Reject tampered state, preserve the immutable source fixture, and retry in a fresh run root.
